title: Otter dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7ff5ff' stop-opacity='0.25'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7ff5ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='45' ry='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M64 78 Q80 82 86 72 Q90 64 82 62 Q76 68 66 72 Z' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <path d='M66 74 Q78 76 82 68' stroke='#b5763a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='82' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#6e4420'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#5a3819'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='20' ry='24' fill='#a06a35'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='13' ry='16' fill='#e8c48a'/>
  <!-- front leg -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='82' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#6e4420'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#5a3819'/>
  <!-- left arm raised up -->
  <path d='M34 48 Q22 40 18 26' stroke='#a06a35' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='24' r='5' fill='#7a4d23'/>
  <!-- right arm out to side -->
  <path d='M66 50 Q80 44 86 34' stroke='#a06a35' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='32' r='5' fill='#7a4d23'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#a06a35'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='19' r='5' fill='#7a4d23'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='19' r='5' fill='#7a4d23'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='19' r='2.5' fill='#c98b4b'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='19' r='2.5' fill='#c98b4b'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#e8c48a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='28' r='2.6' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='28' r='2.6' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='43.9' cy='27' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57.9' cy='27' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#4a2c12'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 38 Q50 42 55 38' stroke='#7a4d23' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M38 34 L30 32 M38 37 L30 38 M62 34 L70 32 M62 37 L70 38' stroke='#d9b37a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
